title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
statement:
Given the heads of two sorted linked lists (represented as arrays), merge the two lists into one sorted linked list and return its array representation.

The list should be made by splicing together the nodes of the first two lists.
constraints:
0 <= N, M <= 10^5
-10^9 <= A[i], B[i] <= 10^9
Both arrays are sorted in non-decreasing order.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers N and M.
Line 2: N space-separated integers (List A).
Line 3: M space-separated integers (List B).
(If a length is 0, the corresponding line may be empty).
outputFormat: N + M space-separated integers representing the merged list.

n, m = map(int, input().split())

b = list(map(int, input().split())) if m > 0 else []
